0022600140.text: The Nuggets (1-2, 10th in the West) visit the Pelicans (0-3) for Denver's fourth game of the season, with Denver on a one-game losing streak and 0-1 on the road. Denver is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise). Denver leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 141-135 win in Denver on October 24, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
